scheme_name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme For Single Girl Child
other_conditions: Applicant must be the only (single) girl child of her family
Applicant must have secured 60% or more marks in the CBSE Class 10th Examination
Applicant must have passed the CBSE Class 10th Examination in 2019
Applicant must be studying in Classes 11th or 12th in a CBSE‑affiliated school
Tuition fee should not exceed ₹1,500 per month (₹6,000 per month for NRI students)
Total enhancement in tuition fees over the two‑year period must not exceed 10% of the original tuition fee
Applicant must be an Indian National (NRI applicants of the Board are also eligible)
benefits_summary: ₹500 per month scholarship paid for a maximum period of two years.
documents_required: Scanned PDF of the undertaking and affidavit (≤ 1 MB)
